grade.definitionKo: 학생들이 공부한 것을 시험 등으로 평가한 결과.
grade.englishDescription: The results of tests, etc., that evaluate what students have studied.
To evaluate a test or game.
A score given after assessing one's scholastic ability.

grade.definitionKo: 바둑, 장기, 태권도, 유도, 검도 등에서 실력에 따라 매기는 등급.
grade.englishDescription: In go, taekwondo, kendo, janggi, or Korean chess, judo, etc., a player's grade based on his/her ability.

grade.definitionKo: 바둑, 장기, 태권도, 유도, 검도 등에서 실력에 따라 매기는 등급을 세는 단위.
grade.englishDescription: In go, taekwondo, kendo, janggi, or Korean chess, judo, etc., a unit for counting a player's level based on his/her ability.

grade.definitionKo: 대학 또는 대학원에서 성적을 표시하는 단위.
grade.englishDescription: The unit for expressing one's academic record in a undergraduate or graduate school.
To grade a test or an assignment.

grade.definitionKo: 바둑, 유도, 태권도 등 단으로 등급을 매기는 운동이나 기술에서 그 단의 수.
grade.englishDescription: A player's level in a sport or skills such as go, judo, taekwondo, etc., measured as a unit of 'dan'.

greasy.definitionKo: 사람이나 동물이 살이 많고 윤기가 있다.
greasy.englishDescription: A person or animal being fat or looking greasy.

greasy.definitionKo: 속이 메스꺼울 정도로 음식에 기름기가 많다.
greasy.englishDescription: Food containing oil so much as to make someone feel nausea.

greasy.definitionKo: 물체의 겉에 윤기가 흘러 매우 매끄럽다.
greasy.englishDescription: The surface of something being sleek and very smooth.

greasy.definitionKo: 잘 닦고 기름칠을 한 듯 표면이 매끄럽고 윤이 나다.
greasy.englishDescription: The surface of something being smooth as if it were polished and greased.

greasy.definitionKo: 잘 닦고 기름칠을 한 듯 표면이 아주 매끄럽다.
greasy.englishDescription: The surface of something being very smooth as if it were polished and greased.

greasy.definitionKo: 잘 닦고 기름칠을 한 듯 표면이 매끄럽고 윤이 나다.
greasy.englishDescription: The surface of something being smooth as if it were polished and greased.

greasy.definitionKo: 겉 부분이 윤기가 흐르고 매우 미끄럽다.
greasy.englishDescription: The surface of something being sleek and very smooth.

greasy.definitionKo: 물기나 기름기, 윤기 등이 많이 흘러서 반질반질하고 매끄럽다.
greasy.englishDescription: Slippery and smooth due to lots of moisture, oiliness, gloss, etc.
The surface of something being glossy and very smooth.

grizzle.definitionKo: 흰 머리카락이 반 정도 섞여 있는 머리.

gwiyangsarihada.definitionKo: (옛날에) 귀양의 형벌을 받고 정해진 지역에 가서 제한된 생활을 하다.
gwiyangsarihada.englishDescription: (archaic) To live in a designated area under limited conditions as a result of having been sent into exile.

gyeonhwon.definitionKo: 후백제를 세운 왕(867~936). 892년에 후백제를 세웠다가 936년에 고려의 왕건에게 항복하였다.
gyeonhwon.englishDescription: The king who founded the Later Baekjae Kingdom (867~936); he founded the Later Baekjae Kingdom in 892 A.D. and surrendered to Wang Geon of the Goryeo Dynasty in 936 A.D.

haenyeo.definitionKo: 바닷속에 들어가 해삼, 전복, 미역 등을 따는 일을 직업으로 하는 여자.
haenyeo.englishDescription: female diver: A woman whose job it is to dive into the sea and gather sea cucumbers, abalone, seaweed, etc.

hale.englishDescription: An old person being healthy and having a straight back.

hatred.englishDescription: The emotion or a feeling of disliking something.

hatred.definitionKo: 생각하기도 싫을 만큼 매우 싫은 느낌.
hatred.englishDescription: A feeling of dislike so strong that one does not even want to think about it.
An act of disliking and hating something or someone.
A feeling of dislike and hatred.
A feeling of intense hatred and resentment.
A feeling of intense hatred and resentment.

hazard.definitionKo: 해를 입거나 다칠 가능성이 있어 안전하지 못함. 또는 그런 상태.
hazard.englishDescription: A state of not being safe due to the possibility of suffering loss or being hurt; or such a state.

hazelnut.definitionKo: 공 모양의 단단한 갈색 껍질 속에 하얗고 익으면 고소한 맛이 나는 속살이 들어 있는 작은 열매.
hazelnut.englishDescription: A small, white nut in a hard, round shell with savory-tasting flesh inside when ripe.

healthiness.definitionKo: 생각이나 의식, 분위기 등이 어둡지 않고 올바름.
healthiness.englishDescription: A state of an atmosphere, behavior, and mindset not being improper nor dark and instead being proper and upright.

hives.definitionKo: 약이나 음식을 잘못 먹거나 또는 환경의 변화로 인해 피부 여기저기에 붉게 솟아오르는 것.
hives.englishDescription: A type of skin disorder featuring red bumps either due to an intake of certain food or medicine, or due to a change in environment.

holograph.definitionKo: 자기 손으로 직접 글씨를 씀. 또는 그 글씨.
holograph.englishDescription: The act of writing letters in one's own hand; the letters written in such a way.

hometown.englishDescription: A place where one was born and grew up.

hometown.definitionKo: 자신이 예전에 살던 고향에 있는 집.
hometown.englishDescription: The house located at one's hometown where one used to live.
One's home that one leaves to move to a city.
One's home that one leaves to move to a city.
The land where one was born and grew up.

horseshoe.englishDescription: An iron shoe placed on the hoof of a horse.

housemate.englishDescription: A person who lives together in the same house.

identicalness.englishDescription: A state in which two or more things are the same when compared.

impartially.definitionKo: 한쪽으로 치우치지 않고 모든 사람에게 고르게.
impartially.englishDescription: In the manner that treats people equally without preferring one over others.
In a sharp and fair manner.

imposing.englishDescription: The outward appearance of something being big and stately.
Towering high above while attracting attention.

imposing.definitionKo: 다른 사람을 압도할 만큼 겉모양이나 기운이 위엄이 있고 대단하다.
imposing.englishDescription: One's appearance or spirit being dignified enough to overwhelm others.
The shape or size of something being amazing.

individually.definitionKo: 함께 있거나 섞이지 않고 하나씩 떨어져서.
individually.englishDescription: Singly without being together with or being mixed with others.
In an individual or personally unique manner.

inferno.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 여러 사람이 처참하고 혼란스러운 상황에 빠져 울부짖고 몸부림치는 상태.
inferno.englishDescription: (figurative) The state in which many people fall into a very cruel, chaotic situation where they cry and struggle.

inoculate.definitionKo: 병의 예방, 치료, 진단, 실험 등을 위해 병원균이나 항독소, 항체 등을 사람이나 동물의 몸속에 넣다.
inoculate.englishDescription: To inject germs, antitoxins, antibodies, etc., into the body of a human or animal for disease prevention, treatment, diagnosis, experiment, etc.

insignificantly.definitionKo: 중요하거나 특별할 것이 없어 겨우 하찮은 것밖에 안 되게.
insignificantly.englishDescription: In a manner of considering something merely trivial without anything important or special.

intend.englishDescription: To have an intention to do something.
To think or plan to do something.

iradeun-ga.definitionKo: 말하는 사람이 말을 하면서 어떤 것이라도 상관이 없는 대상을 예를 들어 열거할 때 사용하는 조사.
iradeun-ga.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used when listing things in which the choice of any one does not matter.

ireonajeoreona.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '이리하나 저리하나' (a conjugated form of '이리하다 저리하다' (do in this way and do in that way)).
An abbreviated word for '이러하나 저러하나' (a conjugated form of '이러하다 저러하다' (be like this and be like that)).

it.definitionKo: 술래잡기에서, 숨은 사람들을 찾아내야 하는 사람.
it.englishDescription: The person who has to find the people hiding in hide-and-seek.

it.definitionKo: 앞에서 이미 이야기한 대상을 가리키는 말.
it.englishDescription: A pronoun used to indicate the previously-mentioned object.

iyamallo.englishDescription: A postpositional particle used to emphatically state something.

jegichagi.definitionKo: 제기를 차면서 노는 한국의 전통 놀이.
jegichagi.englishDescription: A traditional Korean game where players kick a jegi, a traditional Korean toy.

jige.definitionKo: 나무로 등에 짐을 질 수 있도록 만든 한국 고유의 운반 도구.
jige.englishDescription: A-frame carrier or back rack, a traditional Korean wooden carrier that allows one to carry a load on one's back.

jjamppong.definitionKo: 여러 가지 해물과 야채를 볶고 매콤한 국물을 부어 만든 중국식 국수.
jjamppong.englishDescription: Chinese-style noodle dish made by pouring a spicy stock of stir-fried vegetables and seafood over noodles.

kindness.definitionKo: 사람을 대하는 태도가 상냥하고 부드러움. 또는 그런 태도.
kindness.englishDescription: The state of treating someone gently and in a friendly manner, or such an attitude.

kindness.definitionKo: 마음이 너그럽고 따뜻함. 또는 그 마음.
kindness.englishDescription: A state of being broad-minded and warm-hearted, or such an attitude.

kindness.definitionKo: 남을 생각하고 도와주는 마음이 담긴 따뜻한 느낌.
kindness.englishDescription: A feeling of warm-heartedness to consider and help others
One's warm and deep love for someone who is junior to one.

kkokdugaksinoreum.definitionKo: 여러 가지 인형을 무대 위에 번갈아 내세우며 무대 뒤에서 조종하고 그 인형의 동작에 맞추어 조종자가 말을 하며 이야기가 진행되는 한국의 전통 인형극.
kkokdugaksinoreum.englishDescription: A traditional Korean puppet play in which a puppeteer performs a story by putting a number of puppets on stage alternately, controlling their movement form behind the stage, and speaking in unison with the puppets' movements.

knotty.definitionKo: 피부나 사물의 표면 여러 군데가 윤기가 없고 매끄럽지 않다.
knotty.englishDescription: One's skin or the surface of an object being lusterless and rough in some parts.

knotty.definitionKo: 물체의 겉 부분이나 바닥이 여기저기 부풀어 올라 고르지 못한 데가 있다.
knotty.englishDescription: The surface or bottom of something being uneven due to protruding parts here and there.

kongnamul.definitionKo: 노랗고 둥근 콩을 싹을 틔워서 그늘에 두고 물을 주어 뿌리가 자라게 한 식물. 또는 그것으로 만든 나물.
kongnamul.englishDescription: A plant grown by sprouting yellow and round beans, and placing  and watering the sprouted beans in the shade until the roots grow long; or namul, seasoned vegetables, made from the sprouts.

leakage.definitionKo: 물이 새어 나옴. 또는 새어 나오는 물.
귀한 물건이나 정보 등이 불법적으로 외부로 나가 버림. 또는 그것을 내보냄.
leakage.englishDescription: For something contained or stored in one place to flow out.

learning.englishDescription: The act of studying a certain field.

learning.definitionKo: 깊이 생각하여 스스로 이치를 깨달아 알아냄.
learning.englishDescription: The state of realizing and finding out the logic of something by oneself, after thinking about it deeply.

learning.definitionKo: 학문이나 기술 등을 배워서 자기 것으로 만듦.
learning.englishDescription: The act of learning a study, skill, etc., to make it one's own.

learning.definitionKo: 주로 학교에서 지식을 배우기 위해 공부하는 일.
learning.englishDescription: The act of studying to acquire knowledge, usually in school.

learning.definitionKo: 어떤 분야를 체계적으로 배워서 익힘. 또는 그런 지식.
learning.englishDescription: The act of studying a certain field systematically; or such knowledge.

leaving.englishDescription: An act of leaving a place, heading for another place.

lecturer.englishDescription: A person who gives a lecture.

length.definitionKo: 두 개의 물건이나 장소 등이 서로 떨어져 있는 길이.

length.definitionKo: 위에서 아래로 이어지는 방향. 또는 그 길이.

life-boat.definitionKo: 커다란 배에 싣고 다니면서 그 배가 사고를 당한 경우에 사람을 구하기 위해 쓰는 작은 배.
life-boat.englishDescription: A little boat carried in a big ship, used to save people in the case of the ship getting into an accident.

lifespan.englishDescription: The length of time during which a person or animal is alive.

lifespan.definitionKo: 물건이나 시설 등이 쓰일 수 있는 기간.

loon.englishDescription: (teasing) A person who is dull, not smart.

lotus.definitionKo: 잎이 크고 둥글며 붉은색 또는 흰색의 커다란 꽃이 물 위에 떠서 피는, 연못에서 자라는 풀.
lotus.englishDescription: A plant that grows in a pond, which has large round leaves and whose red or white flowers bloom on the surface of the water.

louse.definitionKo: 몸의 길이는 1~4mm로 편평한 모양이며, 사람의 몸에 붙어 살면서 피를 빨아 먹는 곤충.
louse.englishDescription: A blood-sucking insect with a flat body measuring 1-4 mm in length that lives on the body of a human or an animal.

louse.definitionKo: 몸의 길이는 약 2~4mm로 연한 회색을 띠며, 사람의 머리에서 피를 빨아 먹는 곤충.
louse.englishDescription: A blood-sucking insect with a light grey body measuring 1-4 mm in length that lives on the head of a human or an animal.

magic.definitionKo: 초자연적인 능력으로 과학적으로 설명할 수 없는 신기한 일을 하는 기술.

magic.englishDescription: A skill for making scientifically inexplicable, miraculous things happen by wielding supernatural powers.

magic.definitionKo: 초자연적인 능력으로, 또는 사람의 눈을 속여 놀라운 일을 행함. 또는 그런 기술.

mathematics.englishDescription: An academic field on numbers and quantities such as counting numbers, measuring space, etc.

menarche.definitionKo: 여성이 일정한 나이가 되어 자궁에서 주기적으로 피가 나오는 현상이 처음 시작된 것.
menarche.englishDescription: The beginning of a phenomenon in which blood is discharged from a female's uterus regularly after a certain age.

merry-go-round.definitionKo: 목마에 사람을 태우고 빙글빙글 돌아가게 만든 놀이기구.
merry-go-round.englishDescription: A ride for entertaining children, carrying them on wooden horses and going around.

methodology.definitionKo: 학문적 연구를 위한 방법이나 그러한 방법에 관한 이론.
methodology.englishDescription: A method for academic research or a theory on such a method.

methodology.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 하기 위한 방법이나 절차 등에 관한 논리.

mild.englishDescription: One's personality, attitude, etc., being gentle and good.

mild.englishDescription: The energy, nature, etc., of something being soft, neither wild nor strong.

mild.definitionKo: 성격이나 마음씨 등이 순하고 부드러우며 너그럽다.
mild.englishDescription: One's personality, mind, etc., being tender and generous.

One's personality being tender and meek.

The winter weather being quite warm.

miniaturization.definitionKo: 사물의 크기가 작아짐. 또는 그렇게 함.
miniaturization.englishDescription: The size of an object becoming smaller, or making something that way.

misplace.definitionKo: 부주의로 물건 등을 엉뚱한 곳에 떨어뜨리다.
misplace.englishDescription: To drop something carelessly  in the wrong place.

mooring.definitionKo: 배를 대고 매어 놓는 곳이나 비행기를 두는 곳.
mooring.englishDescription: A place where a boat is docked or a plane is kept.

mutation.definitionKo: 유전자의 이상으로 이전에는 없었던 독특한 모습이나 특성이 나타나는 현상.
mutation.englishDescription: A phenomenon in which unique forms or characteristics previously unseen now appear due to a genetic abnormality.

nameplate.definitionKo: 이름이나 직위 등을 써서 책상 위에 놓는 패.

nameplate.definitionKo: 집주인이나 건물의 이름, 주소 등을 적어서 대문 위나 옆에 붙이는 작은 패.
nameplate.englishDescription: A small plate bearing the name of a house owner or building, address, etc., attached on or next to the front entrance.
